required_action: Create/confirm datum plan and zero reference for body centerline
pass_criteria: fixture origin and edge references documented and reproducible
stop_condition: Any cut cannot proceed with unresolved datum alignment

required_action: Record cutter radius/bit width compensation plan and estimate kerf spread
pass_criteria: Compensation row completed and accepted in build/cnc/phase1-cnc-gates.csv
stop_condition: No CNC slot width may be set from slot model alone

required_action: Cut labeled coupons for kerf and edge condition check
pass_criteria: Coupon notes and post-cut dimensions recorded
stop_condition: No tuning cuts until coupon pass criteria met

required_action: Prepare spoilboard registration and clamp layout for 2-side access
pass_criteria: Fixture IDs and clamp points recorded
stop_condition: Any fixture that distorts centerline requires redesign

required_action: Confirm tooling/material for wood/steel mix envelope
pass_criteria: Appropriate tool and coolant strategy logged and validated in shop review

required_action: Run first-article tongue slot mock pass before full panel cut
pass_criteria: Pass/fail with measured deviation and notes
stop_condition: Any oversized/undersize pass requiring unknown correction
